ROC curve and AUC.

Computes ROC curve points and AUC from binary labels and prediction scores.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `ROCCurveNode` |
| Search words | roc, auc, curve |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| actual_col | `actual_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Binary actual label column. Required. |
| score_col | `score_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Numeric positive-class score column. Required. |
| positive_label | `positive_label` | Text | `1` |   | The run | Positive class label. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
